arguments.query: multivariate Hasse derivative linear map polynomial binomial coefficients
The multivariate Hasse derivative of a polynomial sends each monomial to its multi-index binomial coefficient times the reduced monomial.
Multivariate polynomial higher divided Hasse derivative via coefficient of f(X+Y); linear maps on finitely supported monomials
For a polynomial over a commutative semiring in arbitrarily many variables the Hasse derivative of multi-index d is an R-linear map, obtained by extracting a Taylor coefficient in new variables.
